exposure: embryo grade on Day 3 (poor-grade vs. high-grade)
cohort: Live-born singletons (n = 3156) from vitrified-warmed single blastocyst transfer cycles at a tertiary academic medical center.
finding: Poor-grade Day 3 embryos in single frozen-thawed blastocyst transfer cycles are associated with a higher proportion of male neonates but not with adverse neonatal outcomes such as preterm birth, birth weight issues, or congenital malformations.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in the mode of delivery between the poor-grade and high-grade embryo groups.
